intended_object: The canonical group isomorphism between the explicit rank-two type-C Chevalley group Sp₄(K̄) (the "carrier") and the K̄-valued points of the symplectic group scheme Sp₄ over ℤ, where K̄ is the algebraic closure of the index's prime field. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation of Agreement.lean.
explanation: The body composes two equivalences: `SpStd.pointsMulEquivGLSymplecticFin` (carrier → standard symplectic matrix group, which keeps the underlying matrix) and the inverse of `Symplectic.schemePointsMulEquiv` (matrix realization of the scheme points). Both realize the same underlying matrix, so the composite is the natural identification of the two models of Sp₄(K̄), not an arbitrary isomorphism. Later theorems in the file confirm that it matches the numbered simple-root subgroups, the q-power Frobenius and the prime-field Frobenius. Specializing to the index's field and to rank 2 is intrinsic: the definition exists to compare two models of this specific B₂ ambient group, and the general-rank, general-field ingredients already exist as the two composed equivalences. Mathlib has nothing for this object. Faithful.
